name: io.github.nirholas/herald-mcp
title: three.ws Herald
description: Tell your human something in person: a 3D character walks onto the browser tab they have open and says it.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A three.ws API key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…) with the herald:announce scope, or an OAuth access token for the same account, carried as Authorization: Bearer. Required: an announcement is always delivered to the key owner's own sessions. Aliases: THREE_WS_TOKEN, THREE_WS_BEARER. Treat like a password.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the three.ws API. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the announce call.
